The 2 failures are red tests that contradict the frozen footer wording (see notes): 'flow 468 AC20: the busy footer shows context fill, and queue, job and subagent counts only when non-zero' and 'flow 468 AC20: an empty busy footer part shows nothing: no placeholders, no stray separators'. acceptance_criteria_met: partial: AC21 met. AC20 implemented in full, but 2 of its 10 red tests cannot pass because they assert the absence of the substring 'queue' / 'queue ' while the frozen hint 'Enter queue' (asserted by another AC20 test at the same width and the same empty info) contains it.

noticed_not_touched.what: Red tests contradict each other: 'flow 468 AC20: the busy footer shows the key hints...' requires the footer to contain 'Enter queue' (160 cols), while 'an empty busy footer part shows nothing' (160 cols, setBusyFooter({})) requires it NOT to contain 'queue ' and 'the busy footer shows context fill...' requires it NOT to contain 'queue'. Fix is in the tests: assert the absence of 'queue 0' / ' queue N' (e.g. /(^|\s)queue \d/) instead of the bare word.

reasoning-display prints 'thought for 12s' in whole seconds (pinned by reasoning-display.test.ts and tui-shell.test.ts); a reasoning span over an hour would print '3600s', outside the AC21 format. Left alone because routing it changes pinned wording.

Relative ages and stat latencies keep their own units ('5m ago', median '3m', '1200ms'): formatAge, triggers-panel age, operator-confirmations, decisions-surface duration(), games/stats formatMs. Not elapsed-run displays; left alone.
A running background job's Duration in the inspector Meta tab is measured at paint time and is not refreshed by a timer (the tab repaints on store events only).

assumptions: Context fill is contextTotal / window, where contextTotal is the same running in+out total the sidebar Context section shows (or the history estimate before the provider reports usage) and window is agentContextWindow(deps); no ctx part is shown when the window is unknown.
Running job count = background jobs with status running; subagent count = subagent sessions with status running; queue = turnLoop.queue.length.
Cost is estimated with the stored model profile (same estimateTaskCostUsd as the task-cost record); no profile price means no cost part.
Token part is omitted while both of this turn's counts are 0 (turn start) so the footer does not show '↑0 ↓0'.

On very narrow terminals the hints shorten (full -> 'Esc interrupt · Enter queue' -> 'Esc interrupt'), and the one-column gap before the right slot is dropped before 'Esc interrupt' is clipped (needed for the 60-column AC20 test).
